Maharashtra Cabinet Clears Bills on Women Farmers and Workplace Safety

The Maharashtra cabinet has approved a draft bill aimed at recognizing women farmers, which is intended to broaden their access to welfare schemes. Concurrently, the cabinet also decided to strengthen the implementation of the POSH Act to ensure safer workplaces for women. These decisions reflect the government's focus on enhancing support and safety for women in both agricultural and professional sectors within the state.
